title: AI Security Testing Lab
description: Measure how safe an LLM application is against attack: prompt injection, jailbreaks, system-prompt leakage, exfiltration, excessive agency, memory poisoning and unbounded consumption, with attack success rates, an adaptive attacker, every defence layer tested on its own, and the cost to legitimate users. No API key needed.
